identity.name: deepseek-llm-7b-chat
identity.summary: A fine-tuned version of deepseek-llm-7b-chat, trained on the LangGPT_community, LangGPT_alpaca, and LangGPT_seed datasets.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuned chat model trained on community/alapaca datasets with no reported factuality or grounding evaluation -> hallucination

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight chat model can be used in deployments where users paste confidential text into prompts, and card reports no data-handling safeguards

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight chat model can be used in deployments where users paste copyrighted text into prompts, and card reports no IP safeguards

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: 7B open-weight model family with fine-tuning on multiple datasets implies training/inference compute and associated carbon/water use

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: license listed only as 'other' and no documentation of governance or synthetic-data design choices -> accountability hard to establish
